input.free_text_description: This system is a distributed transactions platform that serves Content Creator, Candidate roles. It manages core business objects including author, book. Secondary concerns include authentication functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Content Creator, I want to create and manage author records, so that I can track and organize author data effectively.
As a Content Creator, I want to create and manage book records, so that I can track and organize book data effectively.
As a Content Creator, I want to access the system through a well-defined interface, so that I can perform my tasks efficiently.
As a Candidate, I want to view a summary of my recent activity, so that I can track my progress.
As a Content Creator, I want to update my preferences and settings, so that the system adapts to my needs.
